name: Deploy
on:
  release:
    types: [created]

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:

      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll

        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}

on:

          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin

            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl

          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin

      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:

        run: cargo publish --no-verify

          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl

          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin

      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

name: Deploy
on:
  release:
    types: [created]

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

name: Deploy
on:
  release:
    types: [created]

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

    - name: Build asset

    - name: Update release with new asset

  pages:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin

      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy

      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable

          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin

      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:

      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)

    - name: Deploy to GitHub

      - name: Install Rust (rustup)

on:

jobs:

          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:

  pages:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)

name: Deploy
on:
  release:
    types: [created]

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

    - name: Update release with new asset

    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

name: Deploy
on:
  release:
    types: [created]

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll

          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin

    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}

      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable

    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:

          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin

      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify

  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages

    - name: Deploy to GitHub

        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}

          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl

name: Deploy
on:
  release:
    types: [created]

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            os: ubuntu-20.04
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            os: macos-latest
          - target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            os: windows-latest
    name: Deploy ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust
      run: ci/install-rust.sh stable ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Build asset
      run: ci/make-release-asset.sh ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.target }}
    - name: Update release with new asset
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: gh release upload $MDBOOK_TAG $MDBOOK_ASSET
  pages:
    name: GitHub Pages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Install Rust (rustup)
      run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
    - name: Build book
      run: cargo run -- build guide
    - name: Deploy to GitHub
      env:
        GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: |
        touch guide/book/.nojekyll
        curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-lang/simpleinfra/master/setup-deploy-keys/src/deploy.rs | rustc - -o /tmp/deploy
        cd guide/book
        /tmp/deploy
  publish:
    name: Publish to crates.io
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install Rust (rustup)
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: cargo publish --no-verify
